release.title: Structured Profile Operations, Protected Communication Preferences, and Actionable Professional Onboarding
release.artifactSha256Location: Smarter_Justice_v1.7.11_Exact_Artifact_Test_Record.json (external companion generated after final ZIP testing)

deployment.statement: Code completion and exact-artifact testing do not change production status.

changes.problem: Visible profile-reporting links still fell back to a generic contact message and did not create a governed, trackable profile-operations record.
changes.implementation: Added validated structured public profile requests for correction, duplicate review, suppression, removal, privacy, credential, firm-affiliation, and employment-change issues; safe public reference receipts; source URLs; privacy acknowledgement; audit history; and owner-workspace visibility.
changes.preserved: No instant claim, automatic correction, public requester data exposure, endorsement, ranking, routing, or production service-level promise.

changes.problem: Professional accounts lacked enforceable choices for optional messages and did not expressly protect essential notices from opt-out.
changes.implementation: Added audited account-level language and optional-message preferences while forcing essential security, legal, account, and billing notices to remain enabled.
changes.preserved: No claim of authenticated production email delivery, SMS readiness, billing activation, or provider-side unsubscribe acceptance.

changes.problem: The professional setup checklist described incomplete steps but did not consistently provide direct next actions.
changes.implementation: Added direct action links for unfinished profile, credential, firm, portal-interest, security, support, and communication-preference steps.
changes.preserved: Paused membership applications, payment, review-timing boundaries, and no-lead/no-revenue promises.

tests.path: fresh extraction, clean install/audit, npm test, syntax/JSON, public links, ZIP safety, source equality, local health and fail-closed boundaries
